name: 郑州风云3
group_note: 郑州风云3 (in-game banner: 风云系列之天下无敌 / 'Invincible Under Heaven', a wuxia MUD in the Gu Long-novel-inspired Fengyun series, built by 长孙无情/Xgchen). Has a wizard home directory (u/wiz/u/xxy/) with real gameplay content (skill/NPC files, not dead system-daemon backups) plus a handful of genuinely dead logind.lpc backups under d/wiz/xgchen/, u/wiz/u/china/, u/wiz/u/lxh/ -- confirmed via LOGIN_D=/adm/daemons/logind and MASTER_OB=/adm/obj/master (include/globals.h) that only adm/daemons/logind.lpc and adm/obj/master.lpc are live; the logind.lpc backups were left untouched, but is_killing() call sites under u/wiz/u/xxy/ WERE fixed since those skill/NPC files are ordinary reachable gameplay content, not dead daemon copies. This lib's securityd.lpc is unusual: it does NOT use adm/etc/wizlist at all -- admin status is granted via a hardcoded 'set("wiz_status/xgchen","(admin)")' inside securityd.lpc's own restore_list(), re-applied on every boot, so the ONLY way to get admin on first boot is to register with the English id 'xgchen' (the original author's own wizard id) -- confirmed 'xgchen' is not in logind.lpc's banned_id list. WASM pass fixed: (1) check_legal_name()'s §8.1 byte-doubled bounds (<2||>12 for a nominal '1 to 6 Chinese characters' -> fixed to <1||>6) and an i%2==0 parity gate that, combined with a single-codepoint is_chinese() helper (str[0] check via name[i..<0] slicing), only validated every other character -- removed the parity gate. (2) master.lpc (adm/obj/master.lpc) valid_write() missing the standard 'user == this_object()' guard -- added (valid_read() here already unconditionally returns 1 with no securityd forwarding at all, so it needed no guard). (3) §7.50 is_killing(object) vs is_killing(string id) fixed at 25 call sites across daemon/class/*, cmds/daemon/class/* (a genuine parallel duplicate tree of daemon/, both populated with identical content -- fixed both since neither could be ruled out as dead), cmds/std/{surrender,nuoyi,kill}.lpc, d/wiz/xgchen/touxiang.lpc, and multiple skill/NPC files under u/wiz/u/xxy/ (kungfu skills, mei-po.lpc). Confirmed already correct: securityd.lpc's save_object valid_write() check already compares against query_save_file()+__SAVE_EXTENSION__. httpd.lpc and dns_master.lpc (both the adm/daemons/ copies and stale u/wiz/u/china, u/wiz/u/lxh backup copies) all have real un-gutted socket_*() calls but are commented out of adm/etc/preload and have no other reachable callers -- left fully dormant, matching the established pattern from other libs in this project; no versiond.lpc exists in this lib. log/nosave/ directory was missing -- created it as a precaution (not confirmed boot-blocking). Admin seeded implicitly via the hardcoded xgchen grant (no wizlist file to edit for this lib). Registration verified end-to-end pre- and post-formatter (English id 'xgchen' -> y confirm -> single Chinese name (1-6 chars) -> password + confirm -> email -> gender -> ethnicity menu (0-3, used 0 for 汉族) -> a 'press enter to continue' info-screen gate -> enters 凤求凰客栈), admin permission confirmed via '目前权限：(admin)'. This lib's prompt shows a live clock (matches AGENTS.md §8.3 item 1) -- used --idle 0.4 for registration testing. LPC formatter run across all 9224 .lpc files (9194 written, 20 pre-existing errors, 10 unchanged). No :: parent-call split hits, no case-label-with-trailing-comment candidates, no CJK-respacing/broken-escape hits.
